verdict.rationale: The only evidence of non-prompt editing is a global theme control that sets colors and fonts for the whole app from one place (docs-13), plus a vague mention of refining in the 'app editor' (docs-15). Every other editing path described goes through the AI: natural-language design edits (docs-33) and boards that send instructions to AI (docs-12). Missing for 10: per-element selection, direct inline text editing, per-element style and layout controls without a prompt, and independent or hands-on corroboration of any visual editor.
